content.subject: EMERGENCY — All Personnel Evacuate Deck B
content.body:
ALL CREW — IMMEDIATE ACTION REQUIRED

Evacuate Deck B NOW. Do not stop to collect personal items.

Proceed to Bridge (A1) or Engineering (C1) and await further instruction.

Do not use Corridor B2.

Security Office is sealed. I am attempting to reach Medbay B3.

Do NOT go to B3.

Repeat: DO NOT GO TO B3.

— Security

[This message was the last transmission from the Security Chief's terminal. Timestamp: 2183-03-14T03:47:00Z]
